title: Cracked crystal ball
prompt: A crystal ball the kind a fortune teller might have but only the ball not the stand, by which I mean it is an orb without a pedestal. I'd like it to look like it is painted in water colors with a sort of bohemian style like you might see on a carton of incense in a new agey headshop at the mall
